heat_sources.rule: Each watt enters the model through the interface of the supply that powers it, once; the model creates none. Hall discharge supply -> IF-HALL-THERMAL-v1 discharge keys (incl. return-current heating at the neutralizer HK-08 and plume interception HK-09). Hall magnet supplies -> IF-HALL-THERMAL-v1 coil keys. RF/ICP chain (generator, reflected power, line, match, antenna circuit, ICP plasma) -> IF-ICP-THERMAL-v2 TK-01..TK-04, TK-06..TK-11; matching actuator -> TK-05; ICP electrode-bias supply -> TK-12, TK-13. PPU supply conversion loss of every slot -> the bus ledger's P_loss_W (never an interface key here; CONS-L1 counts it as supply loss outside the accounts). Thermal-control dissipation -> Q_thermal_control_W. Environment -> ENV inputs.
replaced by IF-ICP-THERMAL-v2 (matched_interface). IK-01..IK-07 and IFI-1..IFI-5 stay v1 history; a v1 record is refused (IFI2-10).

equations.name: interface deposition (v2)
equations.form: Q_src,i = sum over interface keys of w_key,i * Q_key; for every key sum_i w_key,i + w_key,EXPORT + w_key,BOUNDARY = 1 exactly
equations.rule: weights are producer partitions (TK-07, TK-12), registered RI-PART partitions (TK-06 split, f_rad, f_up, Hall shares) or the fixed receivers of matched_interface.consumer_deposition; a missing weight set is INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE; never fitted. Signed keys are allowed only for TK-12 and TK-13, with IFI2-08.

receives: Q_icp_plasma_wall_W (producer share, if a wetted surface maps to it)

boundaries.kind: BOOKING BOUNDARY (v2): heat booked here is reported raw by key and sub-account, never as a remainder: RF_SOURCE = Q_icp_rf_conversion_loss_W + P_icp_rf_reflected_W; RF_CHAIN = Q_icp_line_W (unless a co-located segment is registered) + Q_icp_match_W and P_icp_matching_DC_W (unless match_colocated). The true PPU conversion loss of each slot is the bus ledger's P_loss_W (the power model's PPU heat); it is not an interface key of this model and is not booked here a second time. An optional registered conductive link to a registered interface temperature may be declared (unchanged); there is none by default.

energy_boundaries.crossing_terms: In: deposited interface heat, Q_thermal_control_W, absorbed environment, inflow through boundary links. Out: net radiation to SPACE / B_FACILITY, conduction to B_SC / B_PPU_RF / B_FEED. Exported, never deposited: P_hall_exported_W (incl. the jet), Q_icp_extraction_W, Q_icp_outflow_downstream_W, Q_icp_bias_export_W, the EXPORT shares of Q_hall_plasma_radiation_W, Q_icp_radiation_W and Q_icp_outflow_upstream_W. Booked at B_PPU_RF by key (RF_SOURCE, RF_CHAIN), not solved.

energy_boundaries.text: There is no electrical model inside. Electrical powers (P_hall_discharge_W, P_icp_slot_load_sum_W, P_icp_rf_source_DC_W, P_icp_rf_forward_W, P_icp_abs_W, P_icp_collector_bias_W) are references for the interface identities only; none is a spacecraft-side bus draw.

SEC_7_ICP_THERMAL.verbatim: Do NOT accept the current approximation that sends the entire residual to B_PPU_RF.
The physically separated quantities already exposed by NP-ICP shall be consumed at their proper destinations.

Approve the additional ICP thermal keys including: reflected RF power; line loss; matching loss; antenna-circuit / coil loss; absorbed plasma power; collector-bias power; collector-bias deposition; exported bias power; upstream carried-out power; downstream carried-out power.
Approve the per-surface convention: Q_j = L_j + C_j subject to the registered sign convention and conservation check.
RF-source / conversion losses -> B_PPU_RF or appropriate electronics node;
upstream plasma/outflow energy -> registered H-1-facing receiver / interface;
downstream exported power -> EXPORT, not internal heat;
only true PPU conversion loss -> PPU heat.
Preserve IF-ICP-THERMAL-v1 and NP-THERMAL-CATHODELESS v1 as immutable history.
